dedupe_keys.name: dataset of resilience analysis of extensive meshed distribution network to supply feeder outages

description: Matěj Vrtal and the Brno University of Technology team publish a topology workbook for an urban meshed low-voltage distribution-network resilience study. The May 2025 deposit includes Excel data and a README describing MATLAB power-flow and resilience calculations over one year of varying loads. The study examines multiple supply-feeder outages, cascading failures and corrective measures. The file is freely downloadable. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0, while the README says CC BY but links to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the intended licence remains inconsistent. The topology can support comparison of outage scenarios in network simulations. City identity, year, workbook units and completeness of load inputs remain uncertain; the README defers value definitions to the paper and does not publish solver code. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this network. The workbook and reported improvements were not independently checked.
